Winter visitor flow rules
New colleagues will find here how a new handler works

This page explains why orderly animal intake matters at Aurelia Skyways and how the Companion Animal Travel Desk protects welfare, schedule discipline, and crew confidence. A calm start prevents avoidable delay and reduces stress for the traveler and the pet. You must greet each passenger in a measured manner, confirm the booking details, and keep the animal under steady supervision from the first check to the handoff.

When a crate arrives, inspect it before any movement. <<FACT F069>> Check the latch, the vents, the base, and the bedding, then record any defect at once. Do not accept a crate that appears damaged, incomplete, or unsuitable for safe carriage. If the passenger is anxious, use plain language and maintain a steady tone. The desk is not a place for guesswork.

For small dog travel, verify eligibility before you accept the animal for processing. <<FACT F074>> If there is any doubt, pause the intake and seek direction from the senior coordinator. Never improvise around age, fit, or documentation. You are expected to protect the animal as well as the aircraft process.

Handle each case with patience and restraint. Keep the area clean, keep forms legible, and keep the crew informed when a condition may affect loading or transfer. If a traveler such as Rafael Moretti or Aya Cohen shows concern for Basil, listen carefully and answer only with approved guidance. Courtesy is not optional, and speed must never replace careful review.

Remember that every animal is a living responsibility, and careful handling is the standard to keep.
